author: bardic-inspiration
name: Shagmane Yak
summary: A huge long-haired yak that travels in herds and tramples anything it knocks down.
description: Shagmane herds winter on wind-scoured plateaus where the snow is too thin to bury the grass. Highland folk follow them for milk, wool, and dung for fires, and give a wide berth to any herd with calves in it.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the yak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

traits.name: Herd Wall
traits.text: While the yak is within 5 feet of at least one ally, it has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against effects that would move it or give it the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

bonusActions.name: Trample
bonusActions.attackNote: only against a target that has the Prone condition
